exact_contracts: For any source relation and arbitrary target list alphabet, preserving and reflecting the relation as actual List.IsPrefix forces two predecessors of a common upper bound to compare.
An incomparable predecessor pair therefore excludes such a map; no source order axioms, finiteness or injectivity is required.
Actual four-constructor DiamondLe has checked reflexive/transitive/antisymmetric laws and no exact prefix representation.
Natural-number chainAddress via List.replicate has prefix iff <= and is injective.
Actual diamond rank/replicate address is injective and preserving but not reflecting; intended control cannot substitute preservation for reflection.
upstream_api: Lean Core Init/Data/List/Sublist.lean exposes prefix_or_prefix_of_prefix and prefix_replicate_iff through pinned Mathlib.Data.List.Basic. No candidate taxonomy import or native-status change.

contribution_roles.role: formalization, controls, source scouts and correlated review

limits: No mathematical novelty or independent validation.
Only the specified source relation is represented; arbitrary DAG displays, repeated occurrences, typed provenance/dependency/governance roles need separate contracts.
No equivalence with candidate recursive Prefix or Python/JSON relation model.
Source labels, hashes, counts, runtime serialization/compression/IO, whole-library acceptance and RH are outside proof admission.
source_and_failure_preservation: Original candidate modules, previous accepted sources and all failed/stale receipts remain unchanged; source variants/logs in .local/prefix-obstruction/.
